name: Blaxer
look: a bounding boxer dog with red-and-white fur, long yellow legs, a yellow face with a flat muzzle, droopy flame-tipped ears, a white tuft, a lilac spiked collar and a flame tail
entry: It bounds into battle and boxes with its front paws, faster than the eye can follow. The spiked collar round its neck grows from its own fur.
how: Evolve Flachiko at level 16. It learns Fire Fang when it evolves.
